steps.title: Org shell, dashboard, settings, billing read-only
steps.goal: A church leader signs in and lands in their church at `/o/[orgSlug]/dashboard`, can switch between the churches they belong to, and — with `org.settings` — edits every `organization_settings` column the plan defines at `/o/[orgSlug]/settings` (sharing incl. share-link password rule and the founder's new `sermon_share_allow_download`, directory sharing flags, youth/adult ages with `youth_excludes_married` and `adult_groups_include_youth`, event flags, `push_on_bulletin`, timezone, logo upload to `org-assets`) and reads billing status at `/o/[orgSlug]/settings/billing`. The super admin (the founder trialling the app) opens the same pages for any church without being a member, exactly as step 2.1's `requireOrgMember` already allows. Every org page and Server Action runs `requireOrgMember` + `requirePerm`; unknown/non-member slugs 404, missing permissions 403, `suspended` shows a banner and disables writes, `past_due` shows a banner only. The org sidebar exists with Dashboard/Settings/Billing plus sign-out; later steps add their entries. Build and lint/typecheck/test are green; users, sermons, announcements, bulletins are not touched.

## Goal
When you finish, a church leader signs in, lands at `/o/[orgSlug]/dashboard`, switches between their churches, and — with `org.settings` — edits every organization setting the plan defines at `/o/[orgSlug]/settings` (sharing incl. the password rule and the new allow-download rule, directory sharing flags, youth/adult ages and the two group toggles, event flags, `push_on_bulletin`, timezone, logo upload to `org-assets`) and sees a read-only billing page at `/o/[orgSlug]/settings/billing`. The super admin (the founder, trialling the app) opens the same pages for any church without being a member. Every org page and Server Action is guarded by `requireOrgMember` + `requirePerm`: unknown or non-member slugs 404, missing permissions 403, `suspended` shows a banner and disables writes, `past_due` a banner only. The org sidebar exists; steps 3.2–3.5 add their entries. Lint/typecheck/test and the web build are green. Users, sermons, announcements, bulletins and share links are NOT part of this step.

## Inputs / prior state

## Build
1. **Guards** (`apps/web/src/lib/auth/`, extend only):
   - `require-perm.ts`: `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])` — an array means any-of (delegate to `hasAnyPerm`); keep 2.1's 403 mechanism.
   - `require-org.ts`: add `isWritable(ctx)` = `ctx.org.status in ('trial','active','past_due')` (TS mirror of `app.org_writable`) and make `requireWritable(ctx)` throw `organization_suspended` whenever `!isWritable(ctx)` (so `cancelled` is non-writable too). Keep 2.1's membership rule: an `active` membership, or a super admin with `membership_status = null`; non-super users with a missing, `pending` or `disabled` entry get `notFound()`. Rename no field; use `ctx.org.orgId` everywhere.
   - Add `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/not-found.tsx` and, if HANDOFF says `forbidden()` works, `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/forbidden.tsx` ("You do not have the <label> permission — ask a church administrator"). No `error.tsx` fallback unless HANDOFF says `forbidden()` failed.
   - Server Actions never trust the client for the org: they receive `orgSlug`, re-run `requireOrgMember(orgSlug)` and `requirePerm`, validate with Zod, write with the user client only and return `ActionResult` via `toActionError`.
2. **Org routes**:
   - Replace the placeholder `app/(org)/o/page.tsx` (keep the route): `requireUser()`; redirect to `/o/<slug>/dashboard` of `profile.last_org_id` when that org has an active membership, else the first active membership, else `/admin` for super admins, else a "You are not a member of any church yet" page (sign-out button; an invitation or a church administrator adds you). 2.1's login flow and `/invite/[token]` already send non-super users to `/o` (or `next=`); change nothing there unless they land elsewhere — record what you found in HANDOFF.
   - `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/page.tsx` redirects to `/dashboard`.
   - `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`: server component; `await params`; `requireOrgMember(params.orgSlug)`; load the `organizations` row (`trial_ends_at`, `billing_mode`, `contact_email`) through `getOrganizationBySlug(db, slug)` (add it to the organizations query module if missing); render `src/features/org/OrgShell.tsx` (sidebar + top bar) with `OrgNav.tsx`, `OrgSwitcher.tsx`, `StatusBanner.tsx`, church name and logo (signed URL for `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`, cached `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS`; reuse a 2.x signed-URL helper if one exists, else add `src/lib/storage/signed-url.ts` with `getSignedUrl(bucket, path, expiresIn)` on the user client). Top bar: display name/email with a menu holding "Sign out" (2.1's `signOut`) and, for super admins, "Super admin" → `/admin`; when `ctx.isSuperAdmin && ctx.membershipStatus === null` show a slim "Viewing as super admin" strip. Provide `OrgContext` to client components through `src/features/org/org-context.tsx`.
   - `OrgNav`: one config `src/features/org/nav.ts` exporting `NAV_ITEMS: {href, label, icon, requires?: PermissionKey[]}` (any-of); ship Dashboard (all members), Settings and Billing (`org.settings`) plus commented placeholders for later entries (3.2 Users/Invitations, 3.3 Sermons, 3.5 Announcements/Bulletins). Inaccessible items are hidden, not disabled; the active item follows the pathname.
   - `OrgSwitcher` (client): the actor's active memberships; for super admins every org `my_context()` returned (memberships first, then "All churches"). Choosing one calls the Server Action `switchOrg(slug)` (`src/features/org/actions.ts`) → `setLastOrg` → redirect to `/o/<slug>/dashboard`. Hidden with a single entry.
   - `StatusBanner`: `suspended` → red banner on every org page ("This church's account is suspended. Content is read-only until the super admin restores it.") and every form/button in this step disabled via `isWritable(ctx)`; `cancelled` → the same, "This church has been cancelled"; `past_due` → amber ("Payment is past due. Nothing is blocked yet — contact the super admin.", decision 7); `trial` → "Trial ends <date>" from `organizations.trial_ends_at`. Dates in the org timezone via `dates.ts`.
3. **Dashboard** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/dashboard/page.tsx` + `src/features/org/Dashboard.tsx`, server-rendered with the user client through `@church/db` query modules (add `count` helpers there — `{ count: 'exact', head: true }` — if missing):
   - "Published sermons" = `sermons` with `publish_at <= now()`; "Active announcements" = `publish_at <= now() and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())`; "Current bulletin" = the `bulletins` row with `publish_at <= now() and starts_on <= today and ends_on >= today` (today in the org timezone via `dates.ts`; key `queryKeys.bulletins.current(orgId, today)`), shown as title + date range, else "No bulletin for this week". No links yet; 3.3/3.5 add them (`TODO(3.3)`/`TODO(3.5)`).
   - "People with access" = active `org_memberships` — only for holders of any `users.*` permission (others cannot read the rows; never show 0).
   - "Set up your church" checklist (`org.settings` holders): logo uploaded, timezone confirmed, sharing decided, directory sharing decided, ages reviewed, "invite your first users" (link arrives in 3.2); items link to the `/settings#…` section anchors.
   - "Your permissions": the actor's labels under the three `PERMISSION_GROUPS` headers (from `@church/domain`, never hard-coded) with `PERMISSION_TOOLTIPS` (decision 4: the DESIGN §5 mapping ships as default); super admins see "All permissions (super admin)".
4. **Settings page** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/settings/page.tsx` (`requirePerm(ctx, 'org.settings')`), form `src/features/settings/SettingsForm.tsx` (client, RHF + `zodResolver(organizationSettingsSchema)`, one form, sections with the ids above), Server Actions in `src/features/settings/actions.ts`:
   - **General** (`#general`): church name, slug and `contact_email` read-only ("ask the super admin to change these"); `timezone` — a searchable select (`command`) fed by `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')`, helper "Ages, birthdays and 'today' are computed in this timezone"; `invalid_timezone` lands on the field.
   - **Logo** (`#logo`): `src/features/settings/LogoUpload.tsx` — jpeg/png/webp up to the `BUCKETS['org-assets']` limit (client check with a friendly message; the bucket enforces the same). Row-first flow because the insert policy demands it: (a) Server Action `prepareLogoUpload(orgSlug, ext)` computes `path = <orgId>/logo/<crypto.randomUUID()>.<ext>` (`ext` ∈ `jpg|png|webp` from the MIME), sets `logo_path = path` (user client; map SQLSTATE 23514 to "Unsupported file name" in case 1.2 added a check) and returns `{path, previousPath}`; (b) the browser uploads with the user client `storage.from('org-assets').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false })` (plain upload; TUS is for 3.3); (c) success → `confirmLogoUpload(orgSlug, path)` proves the object exists with `createSignedUrl(path, 60)` (not `list()`) and revalidates; (d) failure → `revertLogoUpload(orgSlug, previousPath)`. "Remove logo" sets `logo_path = null` (old object swept by the 3.6 cron — comment it). Preview via signed URL.
   - **Sharing** (`#sharing`): `sermons_shareable` ("Allow leaders to create public share links for sermons"), `sermon_share_requires_password` ("Share links must have a password (minimum 8 characters)"), `sermon_share_allow_download` ("Allow visitors to download uploaded sermon files from share links" — helper: external links always open at the provider; decision 5). Disable the two sub-toggles when `sermons_shareable` is off. Helper: turning sharing off makes every existing share-link page 404 on the next visit; a file URL already handed out stays valid up to 1 hour (DESIGN §7).
   - **Directory** (`#directory`): `directory_share_in_congregation` ("Members can see the church directory"), `directory_share_with_fellowship` ("Share the directory with churches in the same fellowship" — disabled and forced off when the congregation toggle is off, mirroring `fellowship_implies_congregation`; helper quoting decision 2), `fellowship_directory_adults_only` ("Only adults are visible to fellowship churches unless a family opts its children in"). Read-only note: families can hide from the fellowship and from this congregation; leaders can only make a family more private (decision 1; toggles in 5.1).
   - **Ages and groups** (`#ages`): `youth_min_age`, `youth_max_age`, `adult_min_age` (number inputs), `youth_excludes_married` ("Married people are not counted as youth"), `adult_groups_include_youth` ("Men's and Women's groups include youth"). Show the schema's constraint-named refinement errors on the offending field. Helper: "Youth = ages <min>–<max>; adults = <adult_min>+; head and spouse are always adults; children are never in Men's or Women's" (DESIGN §4.3; decision 3 in a comment).
   - **Events** (`#events`): `members_can_submit_events`, `events_require_approval` (helper: "Submissions by members without announcements.create always start as pending"; events UI is step 5.3).
   - **Notifications** (`#notifications`): `push_on_bulletin` ("Send a push notification when a bulletin is uploaded"; decision 6).
   - `saveSettings(orgSlug, input)`: `requireOrgMember` → `requirePerm('org.settings')` → `requireWritable` → `updateSettingsSchema` + `validateSettingsUpdate(current, patch)` → `updateSettings(ctx.org.orgId, patch)` with the user client; map SQLSTATE 23514 and 22023 (`invalid_timezone`) through `toDomainError` to field errors (`ActionResult.error.field`); `0 rows updated` means RLS refused (permission lost mid-session or org no longer writable) — return "You no longer have permission to change settings" and `revalidatePath`. `sonner` toast on success; Save disabled when `!isWritable(ctx)`.
5. **Billing (read-only)** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx` + `src/features/settings/BillingStatus.tsx` (`requirePerm(ctx, 'org.settings')` — DESIGN §5 maps "view billing status" to `org.settings`): `organizations.status` badge (2.2's `StatusBadge`), `billing_mode` (`stripe` / `manual` / `free`) with a one-line explanation each, `trial_ends_at` in the org timezone while `trial`, and, when `billing_mode = 'stripe'`, the latest `billing_subscriptions` row (`updated_at desc`, user client): `status` badge (same colours as `BillingPanel`), `status_raw`, `current_period_end` in the org timezone, `cancel_at_period_end` → "cancels at period end". Price text: "US$50 per month per church, billed by the super admin" (decision 7). No Checkout/Portal buttons (`/api/billing/*` are super admin routes, 2.3); say "Contact the super admin to change billing" (no email hard-coded); `past_due`/`suspended` explanations repeat the banner text.
6. **Shared field definitions**: label/helper/decision text for every settings field in `src/features/settings/fields.ts` so 2.2's `SettingsForm` can import the same labels (touch it only if that is a one-line change).
7. **Queries and keys**: add `getOrganizationBySlug`, the dashboard counts and the current-bulletin read to the `@church/db` query modules (typed against `database.types.ts`; no SQL changes, so no typegen) and `queryKeys.logoUrl(orgId, path)` to `packages/db/src/keys.ts`.
8. **Tests** (Vitest in `apps/web`): `nav.ts` visibility (no permissions → Dashboard only; `org.settings` → Settings and Billing; super admin → all), `requirePerm` with an array and `isWritable` per status, `saveSettings` error mapping (23514 → field error with the constraint name, 22023 → timezone field, 0 rows → permission message) with a mocked client. Schema tests live in `packages/domain` (1.6b) — extend, do not duplicate. If a Playwright smoke spec exists, add: `/o/unknown-slug/dashboard` signed-out → `/login?next=…`.
9. **Docs**: `docs/RLS.md` gets a "Web guards" subsection (how `requireOrgMember`/`requirePerm`/`requireWritable`/`isWritable` map to `my_context()`, `app.has_perm`, `app.org_writable`; why super admins pass). `docs/ENV.md` unchanged.

## Constraints
- Do not edit `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql` or add a migration; if a column or policy is missing, hide the field and record it in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan". Never run `supabase db push` or `db reset`.

steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 3.2a "Users grid, membership actions, detail page" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §4 (tables `profiles`, `org_memberships`, `org_membership_permissions`, `persons`; "Client RPCs" `set_membership_permissions`, `set_membership_status`, `remove_membership`; "Permission mapping for unnamed capabilities"), §5 and §8, and `docs/DESIGN.md` §2 (`apps/web` file list), §4.2 (the same tables, `audit_log`), §4.4 ("RPC semantics" and the column-level `grant select … on public.persons`), §5 (12 permissions, mapping table), §6 (policy rows for those tables), §9 (permission-grid paragraph) and §11 Phase 1 step 7 before writing code. Also read `docs/RLS.md` (mapping, error catalogue, "Web guards" from 3.1) and `HANDOFF.md` ("Deviations from plan", "Decisions"). Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one (3.2b adds invitations, direct accounts and email).

## Goal
When you finish, a church leader with any `users.*` permission opens `/o/[orgSlug]/users` and sees every membership as a grid: one row per user, twelve checkboxes under the three role headers (Sermon manager / Announcement manager / Organization manager — order and membership from `PERMISSION_GROUPS` in `@church/domain`, DESIGN §5), select-all per header, debounced optimistic saves through `set_membership_permissions`, and checkboxes disabled with a tooltip when the actor lacks `users.edit_permissions`. Holders of `users.delete` disable and remove memberships (re-enable and approve need `users.create`); the last-manager guard error reads clearly. `/o/[orgSlug]/users/[membershipId]` shows one membership with an editable permission block, actions and audit rows. Lint/typecheck/test and the web build are green. Invite, Create account, `/invitations` and email are NOT part of this step (3.2b); the directory UI is step 5.1.

## Inputs / prior state
- Step 3.1 created the org shell: `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`, the 2.1 guards extended — `requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext = {org: {orgId, slug, name, status}, membershipStatus, personId, householdId, permissions: PermissionKey[], isSuperAdmin}` (super admins pass with `membershipStatus = null` and satisfy every permission check), `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])` (array = any-of), `isWritable(ctx)`/`requireWritable(ctx)` — plus `src/features/org/nav.ts` (`NAV_ITEMS` with commented placeholders for Users and Invitations), `src/features/org/org-context.tsx`, `StatusBanner`, the dashboard's "invite your first users" checklist item (no link yet) and "People with access" count, and 2.1's `ActionResult<T>` (`src/lib/actions/result.ts`) / `toActionError` (`src/lib/supabase/errors.ts`). Read them first and reuse them; do not duplicate guards.
- Step 2.2b created `src/features/orgs/AdminsPanel.tsx` (members table with "grant all 12", disable/enable, pending invitations with Revoke, one-time invite link) and `src/features/orgs/admin-actions.ts`. Read them; extract shared pieces (status badge, permission-count cell) into `src/features/users/` and import them from `AdminsPanel` only if that is a one-line change — otherwise leave `/admin` untouched.
- `@church/db` (1.7a) `packages/db/src/queries/memberships.ts`: `listMemberships(orgId)` selects `org_memberships` with embedded `org_membership_permissions(permission)` (FK exists) then fetches `profiles` by `user_id in (…)` in a second query and merges `display_name`/`email` in TypeScript (no FK from `org_memberships.user_id` to `profiles`); `getMembership(id)`; `listInvitations(orgId, {pending})`. 2.2b may have added `listMembershipsWithPermissions` — extend ONE of them, never add a third. `keys.ts`: `queryKeys.memberships.list(orgId)`.
- `9999_init.sql` (1.2–1.4c): `profiles (user_id pk, display_name, email citext, last_org_id)`; `org_memberships (id, org_id, user_id, status membership_status, invited_by, approved_by, approved_at, disabled_at)` unique `(org_id, user_id)`; `org_membership_permissions (membership_id, permission, granted_by, granted_at)`; `persons.user_id` (partial unique per org); `audit_log (org_id, actor_user_id, table_name, row_id, action, old_data, new_data, created_at)`. Trigger `app.guard_last_org_manager` blocks removing the last active `users.edit_permissions` holder (permissions or status) and raises `last_org_manager` (SQLSTATE P0001). These tables are audited by trigger — write no audit code.
- Policies (DESIGN §6): `profiles` select = own row or `users.*` holder of a shared org; `org_memberships` and `org_membership_permissions` select = own row or any `users.*` permission, writes RPC-only; `audit_log` select = `org.settings` or super. `persons` base table: `authenticated` has a column-level `select` grant on `id, org_id, household_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, …` (NOT `birthdate`) and the select policy admits exactly the rows visible through `directory_persons`; `select *` on `persons` is rejected (42501). The `directory_persons` view (DESIGN §4.4 sketch, built in 1.3a) has NO `user_id` column — read its column list in `9999_init.sql`.
- RPCs (1.3b): `set_membership_permissions(membership_id, perms[])` — `users.edit_permissions`, org derived from the row, takes the FULL set (the diff is computed in SQL), last-manager guard, audits; `set_membership_status(membership_id, status)` — `disabled` needs `users.delete`, `active` needs `users.create`, `pending` → `invalid_payload`; `remove_membership(membership_id)` — `users.delete`; hard-deletes the membership + permissions, nulls `persons.user_id`, deletes that user's `notification_preferences` for the org and, only when the user has no other active membership, their `push_devices`. Every mutating RPC calls `app.require_writable(org)` → `organization_suspended`. Error keys (catalogue at the top of section (5c) of `9999_init.sql` and in `docs/RLS.md`): `permission_denied` (42501, `detail` = the permission key), `organization_suspended` (42501), `last_org_manager`, `membership_not_found` (P0001), `invalid_payload` (22023).
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `PERMISSION_KEYS` (12-tuple in enum order), `PERMISSION_GROUPS` (three headers, ids `sermon_manager` / `announcement_manager` / `organization_manager`), `PERMISSION_LABELS`, `PERMISSION_TOOLTIPS` (the DESIGN §5 mapping text), `schemas/users.ts` (`setMembershipPermissionsSchema {membership_id, perms}`, `setMembershipStatusSchema {membership_id, status: 'active' | 'disabled'}`, `removeMembershipSchema {membership_id}`), `errors.ts` (`toDomainError`, `errorMessageFor`). `@church/db` `rpc.ts` object-form wrappers: `setMembershipPermissions(db, {membership_id, perms})`, `setMembershipStatus(db, {membership_id, status})`, `removeMembership(db, {membership_id})`.
- Founder decisions binding this step: 4 — "Permission mapping (docs/DESIGN.md §5 table) ships as the default — document it" (tooltips repeat that text); 7 — "only `suspended` blocks writes; `past_due` = banner only". PLAN §4 mapping: "remove access = `users.delete`; invite/create accounts = `users.create` (granting perms also needs `users.edit_permissions`); directory admin = `users.create` or `org.settings`".

## Build
1. **Queries** — extend `packages/db/src/queries/memberships.ts` (typed against `database.types.ts`; you change no SQL): `listMemberships(orgId)` gains the linked directory person through two more queries merged in TypeScript — `persons` base table with an EXPLICIT column list `id, user_id, household_id` where `org_id = orgId and user_id in (<membership user ids>)` (never `select *`), then `directory_persons` selecting `id, first_name, last_name, preferred_name, household_id` where `id in (<ids>)`. A membership whose person is missing or not visible to the actor still renders with `person: null` — never drop a membership row because the person lookup returned nothing. Order by status (`active`, `pending`, `disabled`) then display name. `getMembership(id)` gets the same enrichment. Add `listMembershipAudit(orgId, membershipId, limit = 20)`: `audit_log` where `org_id = orgId and ((table_name = 'org_memberships' and row_id = membershipId) or (table_name = 'org_membership_permissions' and (new_data->>'membership_id' = membershipId or old_data->>'membership_id' = membershipId)))` ordered by `created_at desc` — read `app.audit_row` in `9999_init.sql` first to confirm what `row_id` holds for the composite-PK table and adjust the filter; step 6.2 moves this into `queries/audit.ts`. Keys: reuse `queryKeys.memberships.list(orgId)`; add `.memberships.detail(id)` and `.memberships.audit(id)`.
2. **Nav and dashboard**: uncomment `Users` in `nav.ts` (`/o/[orgSlug]/users`, `requires: ['users.create','users.delete','users.edit_permissions']` — any of them); leave `Invitations` commented for 3.2b. Dashboard: the "People with access" count becomes a link to `/users` for `users.*` holders; the checklist item "invite your first users" links to `/users` for `users.create` holders.
3. **Users page** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/users/page.tsx` (`params` is a Promise): `requireOrgMember` then `requirePerm(ctx, ['users.create','users.delete','users.edit_permissions'])`. The server component loads `listMemberships` with the user client and renders `src/features/users/UsersPage.tsx` (client shell): toolbar with a search box (name/email, client-side), a status filter (Active / Pending / Disabled / All; default Active + Pending) and an `actions` slot that stays empty here (3.2b puts Invite / Create account there), then `PermissionGrid`.
4. **PermissionGrid** (`src/features/users/PermissionGrid.tsx`, client):
   - Rows = memberships; first column = display name (link to `/users/[membershipId]`), email, linked person ("first last · household" or "Not linked to a directory person"; "Not visible to you" when `person` is null and the actor lacks `users.create`/`org.settings`), status badge (`pending` amber, `disabled` grey; `disabled` rows render their checkboxes disabled with the tooltip "Re-enable this user to change permissions"). "(you)" marker on the actor's own row.
   - Columns = the 12 permissions in `PERMISSION_KEYS` order grouped under the three `PERMISSION_GROUPS` headers (labels from `@church/domain`; never hard-code keys or headers). Each row has a select-all checkbox under each header (checked when the row holds every key of the group, indeterminate when some) that toggles that whole group for that row — PLAN §8's "role-header select-all"; a column-wide select-all across users is not required. Header cells and checkboxes carry tooltips: `PERMISSION_LABELS` plus `PERMISSION_TOOLTIPS` (e.g. `users.create` → directory admin + invite/create accounts; `org.settings` → directory admin, settings, billing status, audit, calendars, custom groups; `users.delete` → disable/remove access; `sermons.link`/`sermons.upload` → share links; `announcements.*` → surveys, custom groups, event approval).
   - Without `users.edit_permissions` every checkbox is disabled and the tooltip reads "You need the users.edit_permissions permission to change permissions" (DESIGN §9). When `!isWritable(ctx)` everything is disabled with the 3.1 banner text.
   - Editing model: local state per row (`Set<PermissionKey>`); a change updates the UI immediately (optimistic), then a per-row debounce (400 ms, `src/features/users/use-debounced-permissions.ts`) calls the Server Action `updatePermissions(orgSlug, membershipId, perms[])` with the **full** set. On error revert that row to the last server-confirmed set and toast the mapped message; on success replace the confirmed set. Coalesce: a change arriving while a save is in flight saves again after it resolves (one in-flight request per row). Unticking your own `users.edit_permissions` asks for confirmation first; the DB last-manager guard is the real protection.
   - Put the pure logic (toggle key, toggle group, group state all/some/none, set equality, coalescing state machine) in `src/features/users/permission-grid.logic.ts` and unit-test it.
5. **PermissionPicker** `src/features/users/PermissionPicker.tsx`: a standalone controlled 12-checkbox block (`value: PermissionKey[]`, `onChange`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`) with the three headers and group select-all, driven by `PERMISSION_GROUPS`; used by the detail page here and by 3.2b's dialogs. The grid's cells reuse its checkbox + tooltip pieces so the mapping text lives in one place.
6. **Server Actions** in `src/features/users/actions.ts` (`'use server'`; every action: `requireOrgMember(orgSlug)` → `requirePerm` → `requireWritable(ctx)` → Zod parse with the 1.6b schema → RPC wrapper with the **user** client → `revalidatePath('/o/<slug>/users')` → `ActionResult` via `toActionError`):
   - `updatePermissions(orgSlug, membershipId, perms)` — `users.edit_permissions`; `setMembershipPermissions(db, {membership_id, perms})` with the FULL set.
   - `setMembershipStatus(orgSlug, membershipId, status)` — `'disabled'` requires `users.delete`, `'active'` requires `users.create` (approving a `pending` row or re-enabling); `setMembershipStatus(db, {membership_id, status})`.
   - `removeMembership(orgSlug, membershipId)` — `users.delete`; `removeMembership(db, {membership_id})`.
   Message mapping through `errorMessageFor` with overrides: `last_org_manager` → "This is the last user who can manage permissions; grant users.edit_permissions to someone else first"; `permission_denied` with detail `users.edit_permissions` → "You cannot change permissions without users.edit_permissions"; `membership_not_found`, `invalid_payload`, `organization_suspended` as catalogued. 3.2b appends the invitation and account actions to this file.
7. **Membership actions** `src/features/users/MembershipActions.tsx`: dropdown per row and on the detail page — "Disable access" (`users.delete`; confirm "They keep their account but lose access to this church; you can re-enable them"), "Re-enable" and "Approve" for `pending` rows (`users.create`), "Remove from church" (`users.delete`; destructive confirm listing the RPC's consequences: membership and permissions deleted, directory person unlinked but kept, notification settings for this church removed, push devices only if this was their last church). Hide items the actor cannot perform and Disable/Remove on the actor's own row (no self-removal — leave a comment). Surface the last-manager and `organization_suspended` errors as toasts with the mapped messages.
8. **Detail page** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/users/[membershipId]/page.tsx` (`params` is a Promise): same permission rule as the list; `getMembership` with the user client — `notFound()` when the row is not visible (RLS returns nothing). Sections: profile (display name, email), status with `approved_at` / `disabled_at` / inviter name (`profiles` lookup of `invited_by`, "unknown" when not visible), linked directory person ("Not linked" — linking moves to the directory in step 5.1; no picker here), permissions (`PermissionPicker` bound to `updatePermissions`, same disabled rules and own-row confirmation), `MembershipActions`, and for `org.settings` holders the `listMembershipAudit` rows (actor display name via `profiles`, action, changed permission or status, time in the org timezone).
9. **Tests** (Vitest): `permission-grid.logic.ts` (toggle key, group all/some/none, select-all touches only its group, equality, coalesced save state); `PermissionPicker` group state; the three actions with a mocked context/client (`disabled` without `users.delete` → refused; `active` without `users.create` → refused; `last_org_manager` → the mapped message; `!isWritable` → `organization_suspended`); `listMemberships` merge (a membership without a visible person keeps its row). If `apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` exists, add signed-out `/o/some-church/users` → redirect to `/login?next=…`.
10. **Docs**: `docs/RLS.md` "Web guards" subsection (3.1) gets the users rules: which permission each action needs, the last-manager guard behaviour, and the rule "the only base-table columns read on `persons` are `id`, `user_id`, `household_id`; names come from `directory_persons`".

## Constraints
- Do not edit `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql` and do not add a migration; if an RPC signature differs from the docs, call it as it is in the SQL and note the difference in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan". Never run `supabase db push` or `db reset`.
- Web never holds elevated keys: `src/lib/supabase/service.ts` is NOT imported by any file in this step (direct creation is 3.2b); no `srv_*` RPC is called; no direct table writes on `org_memberships`, `org_membership_permissions`, `persons` or `households` — only the three RPCs through the user client.
- The grid sends the full permission array; never compute diffs client-side for the RPC. Never hard-code the 12 keys or the three headers: import `PERMISSION_KEYS`, `PERMISSION_GROUPS` and labels from `@church/domain`.
- Never `select *` on `persons`/`households`; directory names only through `directory_persons`; no person/household editing UI (5.1); no invite/create/invitations UI (3.2b); no join codes (5.6); no `/admin` changes beyond an optional one-line import.
- Next 16: `params` is a Promise; Server Actions in `'use server'` files; `revalidatePath` after writes; keep 2.1's CSP and headers. Versions: Next 16.3, React 19.2.3 exact, `@supabase/ssr` 0.12, supabase-js 2.112, Zod 4.5, TypeScript ~5.9 (not 7), ESLint 9 (not 10), Tailwind 4, Vitest 4. No new runtime dependency; shadcn components generated into `src/components/ui/*` as needed (`dropdown-menu`, `alert-dialog`, `tooltip`, `popover`).
- No email addresses, keys or model names in code, comments, tests or commits; fixtures use `example.com` addresses only.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → every task succeeds; the new Vitest suites pass (grid logic, picker, actions, merge).
- `pnpm --filter web build` → succeeds and the route list includes `/o/[orgSlug]/users` and `/o/[orgSlug]/users/[membershipId]`.
- `git grep -n "supabase/service" apps/web/src/features apps/web/app/'(org)'` → no hits. `git grep -n "'sermons.upload'\|\"sermons.upload\"" apps/web/src/features/users` → no hits (keys come from `@church/domain`). `git grep -n "from('persons').select('\*')\|select('\*').*persons" apps/web packages/db` → no hits.
- Local DB unchanged: `scripts/db/local-up.sh && scripts/db/apply-migrations.sh && scripts/db/apply-migrations.sh && scripts/db/check-rerunnable.sh && scripts/db/test.sh` → still green (you changed no SQL).
